title: maleCNS-depth: pre-registration and analysis code for the certified information-breaking depth of the male Drosophila CNS connectome
description:
Pre-registered study of the synapse-flow Markov chain of the male Drosophila central nervous system connectome (male-cns v1.0, FlyEM and collaborators, CC-BY).

Registration record: release v0.1.0-prereg (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22980248). Frozen confirmatory analysis: release v0.2.0-frozen (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22981189). The five pre-registered hypotheses were run once, on 26 September 2026: H2 passed, H5 passed as a sensitivity result, H1, H3 and H4 failed (RESULTS_2026-09-26.md, results/, logs/).

This release adds the exploratory analyses made after the confirmatory run, which were not pre-registered and change no verdict (EXPLORATORY_2026-09-26.md, code/exploratory/, exploratory/), and the manuscript draft (paper/, with the compiled PDF).
